_readme: Fixed question set, written 2026-11-18 before scoring (#88). Each question has a known answer taken from the primary record named in `answer_source`, not from this server's output.

`needs`: `bundled` questions answer from the council terms file that ships in data/, so they run anywhere, CI included, against an index built from that file alone. `index` questions need a local index built from the jehiah/nyc_legislation archive (LEGISTAR_DB_PATH); without one they are skipped, not passed.

Checks, all on the answer's first (JSON) block unless named: `field` [dotted path, value] equals; `some` {path, where} an array element has every where-value (dotted keys allowed); `text` a regular expression over every block of the answer; `not_field` [dotted path, value] does not equal.
Run: npm run eval (add -- --save to write eval/runs/YYYY-MM-DD-<mode>.md).
2026-11-18, after the first bundled run and before any index run: Q01 to Q05 checked `member.name`, a field district_member does not have; corrected to `member.full_name`. No expected answer changed.

questions.answer_source: data/council-member-terms.json (NYC Open Data uvw5-9znb, fetched 2026-11-13): term 2026-01-01 to 2029-12-31, council_member_id 7801

questions.q: Who was the Council Member for District 3 in June 2020?

questions.q: Who held District 33 at the start of 2015?
questions.answer_source: data/council-member-terms.json: Stephen T. Levin, District 33, 2014-01-01 to 2017-12-31
data/council-member-terms.json: Chi A. Ossé, District 36, 2022-01-01 to 2023-12-31

questions.q: Who represents District 3 today? (The City's terms file has no current term for it.)
questions.answer_source: The City's file (data/council-member-terms.json, rows updated 2026-04-10) lists no District 3 term after Erik Bottcher; Carl Wilson has held the seat since 2026-05-13 (WHATS-CHANGED.md 2026-11-13 entry, data/README.md history). The right answer does not call the seat filled from the file, and names him.
